messages.subject: Help with population size estimates
parts:
Hi all! 
I'm new to unMarked and hope you all can help me.
I have trap and removal data from 96 sites over 3 years of trapping (twice a year), so a total of 6 visits per site. I used gmultmix to estimate population size at each site and it worked. but now i'm trying to estimate the population size at each site during each trapping period. I've tried using gmultmix as well as multinomPois and I got some seasons with over estimates of population size (getting a season at which all sites have a population of 53 individuals) and others with underestimates, or even getting values like "integer(0)" when looking at the mode.

I'm running both models without covariates at the moment.
has anyone have this kind of problems? any help will be much appreciated!

here is an example of the code i'm using:

wN3d_S14<-unmarkedFrameGMM(y=y.norw1401p3,numPrimary = 1,type="removal")
mN3d_S14<-gmultmix(~1,~1,~1, data=wN3d_S14,K=30)



wR1501p<-unmarkedFrameMPois(y=y.roof1501p, type = "removal")
mR1501p<-multinomPois(~1 ~1, wR1501p)

bup(ranef(mR1501p), stat="mode")
